text: A finish protects wood and makes the grain look great.
Water-based finishes are easiest for kids: low smell and soap-and-water cleanup.
Food-safe mineral oil is good for cutting boards.
Put on thin coats with a rag or brush. Let each coat dry before the next.
Sand lightly with 220 grit between coats.
Rags with oil finishes can catch fire by themselves as they dry.
A grown-up should lay them flat outside to dry or put them in water.

tip.text: Oily rags are a real fire danger. Always tell your grown-up.
